interface.address_unit: physical 128-bit word index from adapter or executor; PS and ISA still use logical bank IDs
interface.read_response: fixed-latency valid, role-indexed data and bank ID; no response backpressure
interface.write: one 128-bit word with 16 byte strobes per accepted request
interface.ownership_input: bank_busy and bank_owner_port from common bank_ownership_table
interface.memory_port: one XPM-compatible synchronous read and byte-enabled write pair per bank
interface.memory_implementation: separate module; this router has no storage

control_rules.authorization: Request role must equal the selected bank's current owner and the bank must be busy.
control_rules.bank_pair_scope: These pairs match build_block in verification/prototypes/smollm2_135m_isa_feasibility.py. A different bank allocation requires a new design revision and proof.
control_rules.range: Bank ID must be 0..12; address must be below its capacity in 128-bit words.
control_rules.in_place: Roles 9 and 14 may read port B and write port A of their owned bank in the same cycle; same-word read-during-write value is not guaranteed and must be avoided by executor scheduling.
control_rules.response_lifetime: Owner may release only after all accepted reads have returned and all writes have been accepted; executor or DMA adapter owns this rule.
control_rules.error: Unauthorized, out-of-range, unsupported-role or unsupported role-bank active request is not accepted; a per-role fault is captured on the request edge and sticky router_error is set on the following edge until reset.

required_cases: authorized DMA write and model-legal read
role mismatch, unsupported pair and out-of-range rejection
two different bank responses in the same cycle
verification.proof_scope: bank-port routing only; no XPM storage, DDR transfer, tensor arithmetic, board execution or full-model inference
